title.zh: 将南甘马粦省 Garchitorena 市镇 Denrica 描笼涯的 Binagasbasan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Denrica 国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Binagasbasan National High School - Denrica High School Annex in Barangay Denrica, Municipality of Garchitorena, Province of Camarines Sur from the Binagasbasan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as The Denrica National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Denrica High School của Trường Trung học Binagasbasan Quốc gia tại Barangay Denrica, Đô thị Garchitorena, Tỉnh Camarines Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Binagasbasan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Denrica Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Denrica High School ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Binagasbasan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Denrica เทศบาล Garchitorena จังหวัด Camarines Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Binagasbasan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Denrica แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Denrica High School, Sekolah Menengah Binagasbasan Nasional di Barangay Denrica, Kotamadya Garchitorena, Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Binagasbasan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Denrica Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Denrica High School, Sekolah Menengah Binagasbasan Kebangsaan di Barangay Denrica, Perbandaran Garchitorena, Wilayah Camarines Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Binagasbasan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Denrica Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Binagasbasan National High School - Denrica High School Annex in Barangay Denrica, Municipality of Garchitorena, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby separated from the Binagasbasan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Denrica National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Binagasbasan National High School - Denrica High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Denrica National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Denrica National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Binagasbasan National High School - Denrica High School Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

Within ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act. Such implementing rules and regulations shall provide for the school's organization, administration, operations and management, in accordance with Republic Act No. 9155, or the "Governance of Basic Education Act of 2001", Republic Act No. 10533, or the "Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013", and other basic education-related laws.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
